final:
type DivZero = { a: int }

safe_div(a: int, b: int) -> int fail DivZero =
  post b != 0
  ex safe_div(7, 2) == 3
  ex safe_div(-7, 2) == -4
  ex safe_div(0, 5) == 0
  if b == 0
    fail DivZero(a: a)
  else
    a // b
